summary: @ornikar/apollo-link-timeout ships install-time dropper that executes obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line, 727 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating string array via WV8StW, hex-coded token table n7gIxM, mangled identifiers) whose content is not inspectable in plain form and whose stated name ('math init') is unrelated to the advertised Apollo GraphQL timeout link functionality. The package.json repository field points at github.com/drcallaway/apollo-link-timeout (author drcallaway@gmail.com), but the tarball is published under the @ornikar scope and adds both the preinstall hook and math_init.js, neither of which exist in the referenced upstream repository. Executing the obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-focused tooling and evades inspection of the code that actually runs on the installer's machine on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
